objective: 在 HangmaRules 冻结的完整公开自摸后继图上，只演化单叶评分程序；搜索、合法性、未知处理、归约、V2 退路与效果评价均由固定骨架拥有。

output.meaning: 单个后继弃牌或条件杠叶的相对质量；不是胜率、摸牌概率或完整赛事收益

fixed_reducer.terminal_hu: always_selected; fixed_score=1.0; conditional settlement support is read from matching COMPLETE ValueRoute by the skeleton
fixed_reducer.future_wall_unknown: forms lower_and_upper_bound; gang is never assumed definitely available
fixed_reducer.future_catch_play_unknown: restricted and unrestricted envelopes form lower_and_upper_bound; candidate cannot choose the better envelope
fixed_reducer.root_aggregation: capacity-multiplicity-weighted lower and upper support scores over every committed positive-capacity edge; capacity is not probability; when the official 20-tile reserve has been reached, the complete empty graph becomes an all-zero Pareto tie and preserves exact V2 order
fixed_reducer.ordering: Pareto non-dominated fronts over all three maximized dimensions; exact V2 order inside one front
fixed_reducer.tamper_guard: PublicSuccessorRoot commits the complete 34-dimensional positive-capacity mask, packed capacities and capacity total; deletion or mutation is rejected

limits.max_leaf_evaluations_derivation: 14 distinct discard roots × 34 draw codes × 2 catch-play envelopes × (14 discard-frontier leaves + 4 gang leaves); this is a structural integrity ceiling, while actual candidate cost remains bounded by counted operations and release runtime gates
limits.state: no mutable module state; deterministic repeated calls

all_or_nothing_fallback: root keys differ from current legal discard keys
root HAND_PROGRESS facts are absent, degraded or inconsistent
a terminal Hu edge lacks an exact COMPLETE normal-draw ValueRoute
candidate compile, runtime, type, finiteness or range failure
fallback_behavior: return no search roots and preserve the exact stable V2 order for the whole window; never fill unknown with zero
forbidden_candidate_behavior: recompute rules, shanten, useful tiles, settlements or legal actions
delete, duplicate or reorder search edges
choose search depth or node limit
treat public capacity as true draw probability
select the more favorable catch-play envelope
assume a conditional gang is definitely legal
perform IO, network, time, randomness, imports, reflection, recursion or unbounded iteration
return a complete DecisionPlan or submit an action

evaluation.zero_table: all frozen draw windows complete; response windows exact fallback; reorder invariant; deleting a positive-capacity edge rejected; at least two sources and two seats show non-tie behavior
evaluation.development: new-source H/M each 8 roots, four seat swaps, two complete tables, 256 tables total; conservative U improvement >0 and H/M non-negative
evaluation.replication: second independent 256-table source with identical source hash
evaluation.confirmation: H/M each 32 roots, four seat swaps, two arms, 1024 complete tables; one-sided 95% lower bound >0, H/M non-inferior, zero rule/execution failures
evaluation.release: runtime optimization, 1s/3s action windows, recovery and official test tournament gates
